description: Coast Conservation & Postal Resource Management - Notifying that the Report of Environmental Impacts Assessment Study on proposed 250 Roomed Hotel Project at Welledewala Road, Unawatuna will be available for inspection from 26.09.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the public inspection and comment period for an Environmental Impact Assessment Report, which is a regulatory requirement under the Coast Conservation and Coastal Resource Management Act. The content is focused on a legal/regulatory process for environmental compliance, not on government personnel, structure, land, commerce, or other specialized categories.
